description: This is a sample C application that tests link event subscriptions and handling via JSON-RPC. It subscribes to specific network link events, registers a callback to process incoming events, and runs indefinitely.

methods.name: eventcb
methods.description: Callback invoked when an RPC server event occurs; parses JSON message and logs event details.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the application.

methods.name: send_subscription_msg
methods.description: Subscribes to link events using json_hal_client_subscribe_event.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes the client, starts the socket thread, subscribes to events, and runs indefinitely.
